text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year! Here's to another great year together!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Heh, as energetic as always. It sure is reassuring having you by my side.
choice_data_list: Do you have any New Year's resolutions?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Of course… To win the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I wanna keep making strides toward that goal. So… what's our first race gonna be?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I resist the urge to comment on her impatience, since I myself spent the New Year break contemplating our future plans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is a race that a only a select few have the honor to join. In order to participate, an Umamusume must be chosen by her fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As such, it's vital that Oguri Cap attract more fans and steadily build up her track record in G1 races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So I reply…
choice_data_list: Why don't we start with your strongest distance?
Why don't we start with your strongest distance?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: My strongest distance, huh? Well, if I had to choose, I guess it'd be sprints. I ran those pretty often back home.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Either that, or miles. Actually, yeah. I'm probably better at running miles.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm sure I'll be able to impress everyone in a mile race!
choice_data_list: Let's show everyone just how great you are.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide that Oguri Cap should start by running the distances she's best at, then build from there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So our next goal is… the NHK Mile Cup!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Anyway, what should we do for our first training session of the year?
choice_data_list: Let's eat a big meal to start the year on a healthy note!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hrm… Going to the gym right after New Year's break?
choice_data_list: Let's get this year off to a strong start!
Let's get this year off to a strong start!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmph… I'm detecting a hint of wishful thinking there. But fine, let's go train.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I have one condition though—that I get to eat once we're done. Food's a necessity when it comes to building strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap and I head to the gym for an intensive workout, then go out to eat. Her post-workout meal more than makes up for the energy burned.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: What?! Are you being serious?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Is it really okay for me to eat?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks so much! To be honest, I was kinda worried about what you were gonna say.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: There are so many delicious things to eat for New Year's… It'd be horrible if I didn't get to have any of it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But I feel much better now. Come on. Let's make the most of all the yummy stuff New Year's has to offer and eat our fill!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some things are better left unsaid, and the amount Oguri Cap eats is one of them—but at least it will help her start the year on a healthy note.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Some new skills?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But I'm always so clumsy. Do you really think I can learn something new?
choice_data_list: You've got plenty of time to practice.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …You're right. The year's only just started after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clumsy though she may be, Oguri Cap makes it clear that she's still determined to take on new challenges. I'm certain that she'll be able to polish her techniques.
